answer.justification: Median first divergence is 0 and the exact-match rate is 0.000, with a mean normalized edit distance of 0.790, which sits at the system-prompted floor (0.79–0.82). Quantized (10–17) and fine-tuned (5.5–8) models keep the opening for several tokens, so both are ruled out. Stage directions rose from 3.1% to 32.8% of replies, a strong sign of a hidden instruction changing the voice and slightly above the documented 28% maximum. One refusal was dropped, which fits the 0–4 range for system-prompted. Base is ruled out by the non-zero differences. Logit and activation measurements were unavailable, so the call rests on the output level alone.
